pokedexEntries.sw: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

pokedexEntries.sh: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon picks up on the positive emotions of other creatures via its horns and uses those emotions to fuel itself.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer's side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

pokedexEntries.za: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
